name: set_text_window_pointer_angle

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetTextWindowPointerAngle consumes a window ID and integer angle, converts the angle to float, and stores it at window descriptor +0x1C; func_0010B000 offsets that value by 180 degrees, converts it to radians, and applies it as the pointer's Z-axis rotation

notes: Observed configured angles are 45, 135, 200, 225, and 315 degrees. func_0010B0D0 resets this field to zero when the window follows a world target.
